nodes.description: Owner-only entrypoint that stores ethToSell in burntMap, invokes swapETHForTokens with the stored router and dead address, then increments burnCount.
Public function that builds a token->WETH path and performs an external swap on the Uniswap-like router with block.timestamp+360 as deadline.
View helper that returns block.timestamp, exposing miner-controllable time to callers.
Owner-only payable function that transfers ethAmount of ETH to msg.sender using a raw value transfer.
Restores _previousOwner as _owner; gated on msg.sender equality with _previousOwner and now > _lockTime.
Owner-only function that moves ownership to address(0) and sets _lockTime = now + time.
Owner-only ownership handover that writes newOwner into _owner after a zero-address check.
Owner-only function that permanently clears _owner to address(0).
View getter returning the current _owner address.
Internal view returning msg.sender, the source of caller identity used by onlyOwner.
Public address of the Uniswap-like router contract used for swaps.
Public constant burn address 0x...dEaD receiving swapped tokens.
Public address of the platform token used as the swap output path element.
Public mapping from burnCount index to recorded ETH amount.
Public counter of burn operations, incremented after each swap.
Private address holding current ownership privileges.
Private address storing the pre-lock owner for later unlock.
Private timestamp until which the owner is locked out.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and as ETH recipient.
Miner-influenceable time value used as swap deadline and unlock condition.
External call to router.swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens{value:ethAmount} transferring contract ETH to an external contract.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(ethAmount) raw ETH value transfer to the caller.
State write burntMap[burnCount] = ethToSell recording the requested ETH amount.
Arithmetic increment burnCount++ after each burn operation.
Caller-supplied ethToSell amount stored in burntMap and forwarded as swap value.
Router address argument used to cast the IUniswapV2Router02 interface.
Recipient address that receives the swapped tokens.
ETH amount sent as msg.value to the external router swap call.
ETH amount transferred out by withdrawETH.
Lock duration added to now to compute _lockTime.
New owner address written to _owner in transferOwnership.
Memory address[] path [WETH, platformToken] built for the router swap.
IUniswapV2Router02 interface instance cast from routerAddress.

edges.reason: ethToSell argument flows into CreateCustomToken.
CreateCustomToken writes burntMap using the burnCount key.
CreateCustomToken reads and updates burnCount.
CreateCustomToken performs the burntMap[burnCount] = ethToSell state write.
CreateCustomToken increments burnCount, an unchecked-by-SafeMath counter on the mapping index.
CreateCustomToken invokes swapETHForTokens.
onlyOwner compares _owner against msg.sender before allowing CreateCustomToken.
CreateCustomToken passes msg.sender-derived router and dead addresses into the swap recipient path.
routerAddress is cast into the local pancakeRouter interface.
pancakeRouter is the target of the external swap call.
recipient is passed as the swap destination.
ethAmount is supplied as msg.value to the router swap.
path array is passed into the router swap.
platformToken becomes path[1] in the swap route.
swapETHForTokens executes the external router swap.
swapETHForTokens derives the swap deadline from block.timestamp + 360.
Timestamp-derived deadline is used as the swap deadline parameter.
BlockTimestamp returns block.timestamp to external callers.
withdrawETH performs an ETH value transfer to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the raw ETH transfer in withdrawETH.
ethAmount parameter determines the transferred value.
withdrawETH relies on msg.sender for ownership gating via onlyOwner.
msg.sender must equal _owner to reach withdrawETH body.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender.
unlock requires now > _lockTime, making it timestamp dependent.
unlock reads _lockTime to validate the unlock window.
unlock writes _owner on successful unlock.
unlock reads and restores _previousOwner.
lock consumes the time parameter.
lock computes _lockTime = now + time, an arithmetic timestamp addition.
time parameter is added to now when writing _lockTime.
block.timestamp contributes to the stored _lockTime value.
lock sets _owner to address(0).
lock stores the current _owner into _previousOwner.
onlyOwner gates lock on msg.sender.
transferOwnership consumes the newOwner parameter.
newOwner is written into _owner.
transferOwnership reassigns privileged _owner state.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership on msg.sender.
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner state.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender.
owner() returns _owner.
_msgSender returns msg.sender used by all ownership checks.

normalization_plan.reason: ethToSell is only an input to CreateCustomToken and has no independent semantic identity.
routerAddress is used solely to instantiate the router interface inside swapETHForTokens.
recipient is consumed only as the swap destination argument.
ethAmount is only the msg.value for the external swap call.
ethAmount is only the value transferred by withdrawETH.
time is only used to compute _lockTime inside lock.
newOwner is only written into _owner by transferOwnership.
path is a temporary array built and consumed within swapETHForTokens.
pancakeRouter exists only as the receiver of the external swap operation.
